short_name: Arabidopsis transcriptomic-metabolomic stress-hormone causal interaction metadata
description: Flat metadata schema for individual dataset records from Arabidopsis thaliana RNA-seq and LC-MS experiments under environmental stress and altered plant hormone levels, including causal interaction observations and supporting reference evidence.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the metadata record within the dataset; use a stable string/UUID or accession-like identifier.

study_id.descr: Identifier linking the record to the parent study, project, or experiment series.

species_scientific_name.descr: Scientific name of the organism; expected value: Arabidopsis thaliana.

ecotype_or_accession.descr: Arabidopsis ecotype/accession used, e.g., Col-0, Ler, Ws-2.

tissue_or_organ.descr: Plant tissue or organ sampled, e.g., leaf, root, shoot, seedling, whole plant.

developmental_stage.descr: Plant developmental stage at sampling, e.g., rosette, 7-day seedling, flowering stage.

growth_condition.descr: Baseline growth condition before treatment, e.g., controlled chamber, soil, hydroponic, photoperiod details.

stress_condition_type.descr: Primary environmental stress applied; examples include drought, salinity, heat, cold, osmotic stress, pathogen challenge, oxidative stress.

stress_condition_detail.descr: Free-text or structured description of the stress treatment, including protocol specifics not captured elsewhere.

stress_severity_value.descr: Numeric intensity of the stress treatment, if applicable; units should be specified in stress_severity_units.

stress_severity_units.descr: Units for stress severity, e.g., mM NaCl, °C, % field capacity, MPa, hours of exposure.

stress_duration_hours.descr: Duration of stress exposure in hours; use decimals if needed.

stress_start_time.descr: Start time of stress application relative to experiment timeline, if known.

hormone_name.descr: Name of the plant hormone or signaling molecule manipulated, e.g., ABA, auxin, salicylic acid, jasmonate, ethylene, gibberellin.

hormone_treatment_type.descr: Type of hormone perturbation, e.g., exogenous application, genetic overexpression, mutant background, inhibitor treatment, depletion, endogenous level alteration.

hormone_level_value.descr: Measured or applied hormone concentration/level as a numeric value, when available.

hormone_level_units.descr: Units for hormone level, e.g., nM, µM, mg/g fresh weight, relative abundance.

hormone_treatment_duration_hours.descr: Duration of hormone treatment in hours.

hormone_sampling_time_hours.descr: Time from hormone treatment to sampling in hours.

rna_seq_assay_performed.descr: Boolean indicating whether RNA-seq was used for this record.

rna_seq_platform.descr: RNA-seq platform or sequencing technology, e.g., Illumina NovaSeq, HiSeq, PacBio Iso-Seq.

rna_seq_library_type.descr: Library preparation type, e.g., polyA-selected, total RNA, stranded mRNA.

rna_seq_read_length_bp.descr: Sequencing read length in base pairs.

rna_seq_reference_genome.descr: Reference genome version used for alignment or quantification.

rna_seq_analysis_pipeline.descr: Name/version of the RNA-seq processing pipeline or key software used.

metabolomics_assay_performed.descr: Boolean indicating whether LC-MS metabolomics was used for this record.

lcms_platform.descr: LC-MS instrument/platform, e.g., Q Exactive, Orbitrap, triple quadrupole.

lcms_mode.descr: Ionization and acquisition mode, e.g., positive ESI, negative ESI, targeted, untargeted.

metabolite_identifier.descr: Metabolite name or identifier; preferably HMDB, KEGG, PubChem, or internal ID.

metabolite_class.descr: Metabolite class/category, e.g., amino acid, organic acid, lipid, flavonoid, sugar, hormone metabolite.

metabolite_abundance_value.descr: Measured metabolite abundance or concentration value.

metabolite_abundance_units.descr: Units for metabolite abundance, e.g., arbitrary units, µmol/g FW, peak area, log2 intensity.

gene_identifier.descr: Gene identifier affected in the record, preferably Arabidopsis locus ID such as AT1G01010.

gene_symbol.descr: Common gene symbol or shorthand, if available.

gene_product_or_function.descr: Brief annotation of the gene product or functional role relevant to the interaction.

expression_change_value.descr: Quantitative gene expression change, such as fold change or log2 fold change.

expression_change_units.descr: Units for expression change, e.g., log2FC, fold change, TPM, counts per million.

expression_change_direction.descr: Direction of expression change relative to control; use values like up, down, unchanged.

metabolite_change_value.descr: Quantitative metabolite change relative to control, such as fold change or log2 fold change.

metabolite_change_units.descr: Units for metabolite change, e.g., log2FC, fold change, normalized intensity.

metabolite_change_direction.descr: Direction of metabolite abundance change relative to control; use values like up, down, unchanged.

causal_interaction_type.descr: Type of inferred causal relationship, e.g., activates, represses, modulates, upstream_of, downstream_of, feedback_on.

causal_interaction_direction.descr: Directional relationship between hormone signaling and stress response, e.g., hormone_to_stress, stress_to_hormone, bidirectional.

causal_interaction_strength.descr: Numeric estimate of interaction strength or effect size, if derived; use a consistent scale.

causal_interaction_units.descr: Units or scale for causal_interaction_strength, e.g., odds ratio, standardized effect size, correlation-like score.

causal_inference_method.descr: Method used to infer causality, e.g., genetic perturbation, time-series analysis, mediation analysis, Bayesian network, knockout/overexpression comparison.

causal_evidence_level.descr: Evidence strength classification for the causal claim, e.g., direct, inferred, supportive, low-confidence.

interaction_supported_by_reference.descr: Boolean indicating whether the interaction is supported by external reference data from existing studies.

reference_study_id.descr: Identifier for the supporting study, e.g., PMID, DOI, accession, or internal reference ID.

reference_authors.descr: First author or authorship string for the supporting study.

reference_year.descr: Publication year of the supporting study.

reference_title.descr: Title of the supporting study or reference dataset.

reference_journal_or_source.descr: Journal, database, or repository where the reference evidence was published.

reference_evidence_summary.descr: Concise summary of the evidence from the reference study that supports the interaction.

reference_url.descr: Resolvable URL, DOI link, or accession URL for the supporting evidence.

replicate_count.descr: Number of biological replicates used for this record.

technical_replicate_count.descr: Number of technical replicates, if applicable.

sample_id.descr: Identifier for the biological sample associated with the record.

control_sample_id.descr: Identifier for the matched control sample used for comparison.

normalization_method.descr: Normalization method used for expression or metabolite quantification, e.g., DESeq2 size factors, TPM, internal standard normalization.

statistical_significance_pvalue.descr: P-value associated with the reported change or interaction, if available.

multiple_testing_correction_method.descr: Method used for multiple testing correction, e.g., FDR, Bonferroni, Benjamini-Hochberg.

adjusted_pvalue.descr: Adjusted p-value or q-value after multiple testing correction.

confidence_score.descr: Optional normalized confidence score for the record or interaction, on a defined scale.

notes.descr: Free-text notes for exceptions, ambiguities, or additional context not captured by other fields.
